cms.summary: Can our daily work and duties become a path to inner peace? Vedanta says the division between work and spiritual practice is the real problem. We look at the knots of the doer, the enjoyer and attachment; the four instructions of Gita 2.47; yoga as equanimity (Gita 2.48) and skill in action; work as offering (Gita 3.9); and seva, serving all as manifestations of God. The class ends with practices to bring this attitude into home, work and family life.
reflection_questions: Which of my daily hours feels most separate from my spiritual life?
Think of a recurring task I dislike. Is the discomfort in the task, or in my resistance to it?
Which of the three knots (the doer, the enjoyer, attachment) is strongest in me this week?
What is one task where I confuse caring about the work with needing the result?
Recall a time I worked at my best. Was my mind on the task or on the result?
